name: pstack-program-dossier
description: Chief (owned-954) SoT for an active pstack program. Mirrors the Orchestrate brief template. Not sandbox /project intake.

fields.hint: Display name; slug stays on sessions/pstack/<slug>/

fields.prompt: GOAL — one sentence outcome a stranger can execute?

fields.hint: Sticky until Julius says new task / exit pstack

options.title: Investigation
options.description: Read-only: how / why / are we sure

options.title: Feature
options.description: New or changed behavior from a named data shape

options.title: Prototype
options.description: Cheap sketch to settle an empirical fork

options.title: Babysit
options.description: Drive a PR / stack to merge-ready

options.title: Autonomous run
options.description: One long task to a checkable predicate

options.title: Orchestrate
options.description: Multi-unit program; chief owns queue + store

fields.prompt: SCOPE — paths this program may write; paths it may not?
fields.hint: One path or rule per line

fields.prompt: CONTEXT — file/PR pointers; upstream reports workers cannot see?
VERIFY — exact command or surface + known gotchas?

fields.default: no installs; no secrets; never LINK/YFI/WBTC as generic workers

fields.prompt: TIMEBOX — rough cap per unit or whole program?
fields.default: one session per unit; partial on expiry

fields.prompt: Planned units sketch (id · role · one-line goal)?
fields.hint: u1 how-explorer · u2 worker · u3 verifier — chief fills as program evolves

fields.prompt: Default spawn host for units: imac | local | auto?
Cover image path (relative to sessions/pstack/<slug>/ or repo root)?
fields.hint: e.g. assets/cover.png — rendered in the DOSSIER portrait slot via chafa when present; falls back to the unit gotchi ASCII

fields.prompt: PM cAavegotchi id (hero assigned as project PM)?
fields.hint: e.g. starter-dai-h1-1 — shown in the DOSSIER header when set; never minted here
